name: Baked Pear with Cardamom
ingredients: ½ tsp cardamom powder and ½ tsp cinnamon
1 cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy yogurt
steps: Mix the oats, spices, oil, orange zest and salt.
Place the pears cut-side up in a baking dish and press the oat mixture into the hollows.
Add 3 tbsp water to the dish and bake for 25 minutes until tender.
Serve warm with the soy yogurt.
note: Pears provide natural sweetness; the high-protein soy yogurt adds protein.
